Package com.privatechain.core.event

Interface BlockchainEventListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
BlockBroadcaster, GossipProtocol
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface BlockchainEventListener
Listener interface for receiving events from the BlockchainEventBus.

Register implementations with BlockchainEventBus.register(BlockchainEventListener) to receive asynchronous notifications about blockchain state changes (FR-EVENT-01, FR-EVENT-02).

Event delivery is asynchronous and non-blocking: the triggering operation (e.g., Blockchain.addBlock(com.privatechain.core.model.Block)) completes before listeners are invoked, so listeners must not assume they can synchronously affect the outcome of the operation that generated the event (FR-EVENT-03).

Implementation contract

  • Implementations must not throw unchecked exceptions; any exception thrown is caught by the event bus and logged, then discarded.
  • Long-running or blocking work (e.g., database writes, HTTP calls) should be offloaded to a separate executor to avoid delaying other listeners.
  • Implementations must be thread-safe because onEvent(com.privatechain.core.event.BlockchainEvent) may be called from the event-bus delivery thread concurrently with other lifecycle methods.

Usage example


 eventBus.register(event -> {
     if (event instanceof BlockchainEvent.BlockAddedEvent added) {
         auditLog.record(added.getBlock());
     }
 });

1.0.0
